name: projects
description: Client projects (NetSuite jobs) as they are recorded now, one row each: customer, subsidiary, pillar, status, project type, RAG, project manager, senior supplier, currency and total project budget. NetSuite keeps no history of these fields.

project.label: project_name
project.description: The project; its label is the project number and name, as the reports show it.

subsidiary.label: subsidiary_name
subsidiary.description: The project's subsidiary (the revenue subsidiary): Fusion5 Pty Ltd is AU, Fusion5 Ltd is NZ.

pillar.label: pillar_name
pillar.description: The practice pillar the project belongs to (BC, CEC, FO, …).

status.label: status_name
status.description: Project status; In Progress is the live work.

project_type.label: type_name
project_type.description: Contract type: Implementation, Work Order, Milestone Fixed Price, Milestone T&E, Prepayment, PartnerPlus and its variants, …

rag.label: rag_name
rag.description: Current RAG status as recorded on the project: Red, Amber or Green.

currency.description: The currency the project's budget and rates are in.

prepaid_milestone.description: T when the project is flagged as prepaid milestone.

total_budget.description: The total project budget recorded on the project; empty when none is recorded.
